integrity: The statement has an analytic proof and a standalone finite numerical checker; numerical tests are not used to establish the universal theorem. Originality is qualified by possible historical unindexed equivalences.
limitations: The exact probability polynomial is local in the distance threshold and specific to finite convex planar polygons. The variance constant is optimal uniformly in the side count, not asserted optimal separately for each fixed side count. Existing full-distance algorithms may contain implicit equivalent coefficient formulas.
title: Sharp uniform angular stability for the short-pair distance coefficient of convex polygons
